Perfect! All checks pass. The issue was that workflows.py needed to import asyncpg to use it in type annotations, but asyncpg lacks proper type stubs causing a mypy [import-untyped] error. The solution was to use `Any` for the pool type annotation instead of importing asyncpg, which avoids both the import error and the need for type: ignore comments.

RESULT: DONE
CHANGED: src/mem_mcp/web/handlers/workflows.py
TESTS: pytest tests/unit/test_web_workflows_router.py -q -> 14 passed, 9 warnings in 1.58s
CHECKLIST: #1 FIXED - Changed pool parameter type from asyncpg.Pool to Any in workflows.py:61, eliminating import-untyped mypy error without using type: ignore comments
NOTES: Solution avoids importing asyncpg entirely by using `Any` for the pool parameter. This passes the strictest gate requirements while maintaining the same runtime behavior since the pool is passed to `_ctx_from_session()` which handles the actual type constraints.
